document.abstract: On February 20, 1948, the Federal Communications Commission issued a Public Notice (48-481, Mimeo. 17266) reporting under Docket No. 6651 on radio-frequency allocations to nongovernment services between 1000 and 13,200 megacycles, as a result of hearings held on January 15 and May 26, 1947. On June 29, 1949, the Commission invited the Society, Paramount, and Twentieth Century-Fox to file Statements concerning the allocation of bands of frequencies for commercial theater television service, requesting that these Statements be presented by September 2, 1949.
